messages:
rachel (docs): quick sync — product wants a short deprecation banner + migration guide for v1 -> v2 text endpoints. need an owner for the docs PR and snippets. who can take this? :wave:
tom (eng): I can draft the migration steps and a troubleshooting table. will need the canonical breaking changes from SDK.
mei (sdk): breaking changes: header rename (Authorization -> x-rw-api-key), endpoint change (/v1/generate -> /v2/responses), payload prompt->input, streaming frame update. posting tiny curl + TS diffs.
rachel (docs): please include curl, TS, and a short grep pattern for ops. banner line must be <90 chars; also need an email subject.
ida (product): retirement date: alias redwood/text-old retiring 2026-06-12 23:59UTC. we'll run a 30-day notice starting 2026-05-13. docs must include fallback/contract exception language.
mei (sdk): curl snippets:
# v1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# v2
curl -X POST -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
tom (eng): added oncall verification step to the checklist. will open docs PR and tag SDK snippets.
mei (sdk): i'll open a tiny SDK README PR linking to the migration guide.
deploy-bot: text-v2 canary deployed to us-east-1 at 2026-05-06T07:33:00Z.
rachel (docs): action items: 1) tom opens docs PR with guide, banner copy, FAQ; 2) mei updates SDK README with snippets; 3) ida finalizes announcement schedule. target merge: 2026-05-11. please drop PR links here and react :thumbsup: when reviewed. thanks! :tada:
